title: HS Prannoy Crashes Out of Taipei Open
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler HS Prannoy suffered an early exit from the Taipei Open, a setback for his tournament campaign.
summary: HS Prannoy was defeated by Hong Kong's Jason Gunawan in straight games, ending his run at the Taipei Open 2026.

title: Sai Praneeth Ended India's 36-Year Worlds Medal Wait
indian_angle: This feature revisits Sai Praneeth's historic bronze medal, a significant achievement that broke a long drought for India in men's singles at the World Championships.
summary: A look back at Sai Praneeth's 2019 World Championships bronze, which marked the end of India's 36-year wait for a men's singles medal.

title: Sindhu, Shetty Exit China Open Super 1000
indian_angle: India's star PV Sindhu and promising Ayush Shetty both exited the prestigious China Open after failing to convert crucial match points.
summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty were eliminated from the China Open Super 1000, both losing after holding match points.

title: Sindhu Wins Japan Open, Beats Yamaguchi
indian_angle: PV Sindhu secured a major title at the Japan Open, defeating home favourite Akane Yamaguchi in a dominant performance.
summary: PV Sindhu clinched her maiden Japan Open title with a scorching victory against Akane Yamaguchi, marking a strong comeback.

title: New 3x15 Scoring for Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: A significant change in scoring format, 3x15, is set to be implemented across all domestic badminton tournaments in India, starting in Ernakulam.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the adoption of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic tournaments, debuting in Ernakulam.
